title: Sprinkler Count Calculator: Heads per Lawn
description: Estimate how many sprinkler heads a lawn or bed needs with the Sprinkler Count Calculator — from head spacing and area, first-pass layout. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a 5,000 sq ft lawn with heads at 15 ft spacing needs about 23 heads — the first-pass count a quote should be within shouting distance of.
quick_answer: The Sprinkler Count Calculator estimates sprinkler heads from an area and the heads' spacing — each head in a layout effectively serves a square of ground set by its spacing. Enter lawn size and spacing and read the count — a first-pass layout number for planning and quote-checking.

Head-to-head coverage (spacing equal to throw radius) is the design rule; the count sizes the pipe, valve and weekend budget.
12 ft spacing serves 144 sq ft per head; 18 ft serves 324. Wider spacing halves the count and tests the heads' real throw — the table shows the trade.
Heads per zone follow from flow; total heads first (this page), then the zone split has something to divide.
At 15 ft spacing: 5,000 ÷ 225 = 22.2 → 23 heads. At 12 ft: 35 heads. At 18 ft: 16. The count is the spacing decision wearing a number.

body.t: A 15 ft throw covers a 707 sq ft circle — but circles don't tile; overlapped squares do. Spacing-based counting (225 sq ft per head) already includes the overlap honest layouts need.
